threshold_justification: The standard classification threshold of 0.50 fails in heavily imbalanced clinical regimes (readmission incidence ~10%), yielding high false negatives. We selected an operational threshold of 0.13 calibrated on the validation cohort to maximize sensitivity/recall. In post-acute care management, the clinical and financial penalty of an unflagged readmission (emergency re-hospitalization, CMS HRRP penalties) vastly exceeds the cost of a preventive phone call or outpatient transition care intervention.
